gamerule.durable_sponges.absorption_time: Sponges keep absorbing water for a short duration. Values must be between 1 and 10 seconds
gamerule.durable_sponges.delay_before_dr: After absorbing water, a wet sponge cannot be dried for this delay. Set to 0 to disable drying
gamerule.durable_sponges.absorption_rang: Sponge absorption range with low heat
Sets the absorption range for sponges with low heat. Must be between 1 and 8
Sponge absorption range with medium heat
Sets the absorption range for sponges with medium heat. Must be between 1 and 8
Sponge absorption range with high heat
Sets the absorption range for sponges with high heat. Must be between 1 and 8
